# @prunelle/i18n Reference

> Locale URL rewriting, dictionary translation, `<html lang>`, automatic internal link prefixing, `hreflang` alternates, localized prerendering, `Intl` formatters, and missing-key checks.

## Imports

- `@prunelle/i18n`: `i18n`, `stripLocalePrefix`, `localizePath`, `alternateLinks`, `formatDate`, `formatNumber`; type `I18nOptions`.

## Plugin Setup (`i18n(options)`)

- `locales`: `string[]` (e.g. `['en', 'fr']`).
- `defaultLocale`: `string` (e.g. `'en'`).
- `messages`: `Record<locale, Record<key, string>>` (optional; falls back to `defaultLocale`, then returns `key`).
- `prefixDefault`: `boolean` (default `false`; when `true`, default locale is also prefixed as `/en/...`).
- `site`: optional public origin (inherits `PrunelleConfig.site`); when set, injects `<link rel="alternate" hreflang="...">` tags into `<head>`.

## Mounted Routes, Rewriting & `ctx.locals`

- Request rewrite: strips `/<locale>` prefix (e.g. `/fr/about` → `/about`) before routing and populates `ctx.locals`:
  - `ctx.locals.locale`: active locale string
  - `ctx.locals.t(key)`: translate string for active locale
  - `ctx.locals.localize(path, targetLocale?)`: build localized path
  - `ctx.locals.alternates()`: `Array<{ locale, href }>` for the current page
- Mounted route: `GET /_i18n/locales` → `{ locales, defaultLocale, current }`.
- HTML & build integration:
  - Sets `<html lang={locale}>` and `hreflang` links in `head()`.
  - Prefixes internal `<a href="/...">` for non-default locales (`data-no-localize` opts a link out, e.g. language switchers; skips `/_pru/`, `/_i18n/`, already-prefixed paths).
  - Expands `prerenderPaths` across all configured locales and shares `I18N_CONFIG_SERVICE` with `@prunelle/seo` for multilingual `sitemap.xml`.
- Checks & CLI: `prunelle check` fails on translation keys missing vs `defaultLocale`; `prunelle i18n-check` prints missing keys.

## Helpers

- `localizePath(pathname, targetLocale, defaultLocale, locales, prefixDefault?)`
- `stripLocalePrefix(pathname, locales)` → `{ locale, path }`
- `alternateLinks(pathname, { site?, locales, defaultLocale, prefixDefault? })`
- `formatDate(value, locale, options?)`, `formatNumber(value, locale, options?)`

## Snippets

```ts
// prunelle.config.ts
import { i18n } from '@prunelle/i18n'
import { defineConfig } from 'prunelle/config'

export default defineConfig({
  site: 'https://example.com',
  plugins: [i18n({ locales: ['en', 'fr'], defaultLocale: 'en', messages: { en: { hello: 'Hello' }, fr: { hello: 'Bonjour' } } })],
})
```

```tsx
// src/routes/index.tsx
import type { PageProps } from 'prunelle'

export default function Home({ locals }: PageProps) {
  return (
    <main>
      <h1>{locals.t?.('hello')}</h1>
      <a href={locals.localize?.('/', 'fr')} data-no-localize>Français</a>
    </main>
  )
}
```
